svg.title: DEM inference pipeline on the NexArm
svg.desc: Camera frames resized to 256 by 256, the task instruction and the z-scored joint state go in. DINOv3 ConvNeXt-B gives 256 stage-3 tokens per view and a frozen NeoBERT gives 32 instruction tokens; with the state token they form an 801-token context. On the NexArm the instruction and the state also enter every head block through adaptive layer norm. The MeanFlow head turns Gaussian noise into a 16-step action chunk in one forward pass, and the arm runs the first 8 before looking again.
svg.text: DEM turns noise into 16 actions in one step.

g.text: starts at zero = the paper's head
